description: Records whose top-level steps still speak US institutions and await restructuring: the class-(a) remainder from the global-resolution audit (PR #382) plus the wave-2 step-level re-audit's class-(c) failures (process-level geoNotes or geo method options do not exempt a record; the test is the step's own label/guidance). Restructuring one means moving the US mechanics into a step-level geoResolutions US entry so the step text becomes the global abstraction (the first-wave pattern pinned in lib/__tests__/processGeoResolutions.test.ts). When a record is restructured, remove it here; lib/__tests__/processGeoResolutions.test.ts fails if a listed record already carries resolutions, or if a listed id leaves the corpus.
